Game Overview

Ino Valentines is a adventure title where guide an anime hero through perilous 2D worlds filled with zombies and traps. Master double-jumps and strategic timing to gather heart-shaped chocolates, overcoming increasingly complex levels. Your mission is love; reach your girlfriend safely while conquering every treacherous terrain in this thrilling platformer.
